author: mark
text:
v0.2 streaming end-to-end ships.

Children all closed:
- bl-f8bd extracted lernie-provider-anthropic to a workspace crate
  (binary compiles independently of the harness).
- bl-bf79 lifted the adapter wire types into src/provider/wire/ so
  out-of-tree adapters need no harness dep.
- bl-64cf added Client::send_streaming + the raw Anthropic SSE Event
  enum with accumulator + Error::Sse.
- bl-de80 wired the §4.4 normalized JSONL stream end-to-end:
  message_start / content_block_start / text_delta / tool_use_delta /
  content_block_stop / message_stop with usage + api_calls; SIGTERM
  → terminal retryable error within 5s; describe.capabilities adds
  "streaming".

Gates green:
- bl-4033 tests: cargo fmt + clippy -D warnings + tarpaulin
  --fail-under 100 across the workspace.
- bl-403c docs: ARCH §4.4 / README / module docstrings audit; pinned
  the blocking-vs-async / commit-cadence decision in the adapter
  streaming module.
- bl-48dd alignment: banned-term grep clean across new code and epic
  commit messages; identifiers match ARCH §4.4; one stray "HTTP
  call" tightened to "HTTP request / API call".
